_meta.label: English
_meta.note: The reference catalogue. Every key here should exist in every other locale; `indiedeck locales check` reports the gaps. Registry-sourced text (compat rule messages, engine names, config setting labels) is NOT listed here - it lives in registry/ in English and other locales override it under the compat.* / registry.* / configSchema.* prefixes.

font-bundle-mismatch.message: TMP font bundle(s) present ({installed}) but none matches Unity {unityVersion} - translated text will render as blank boxes.
font-bundle-mismatch.fix: Install {bundle} and point FallbackFontTextMeshPro at it.

font-bundle-clutter.message: {count} TMP font bundle(s) for other Unity versions are sitting in the game folder ({unused}).
font-bundle-clutter.fix: Only {bundle} is used here; the rest are dead weight.

loaders-stacked.message: {count} mod loaders are installed at once: {loaders}.
loaders-stacked.fix: Keep the one the translator actually uses; ReiPatcher in particular is documented as incompatible with other plugin managers.

translator-payload-orphaned.message: {translator} files for the "{variant}" variant are installed, but no loader providing "{capability}" is present - nothing will load them.
translator-payload-orphaned.fix: Install the matching loader, or remove the stray files and install the variant that fits the loader you have.

translator-outdated.message: {translator} {installed} installed; {latest} is the newest known release.

translator-endpoint-too-old.message: {translator} {installed} predates the 5.5.2 DeepL auth fix; the DeepL API will reject its requests.
translator-endpoint-too-old.fix: Upgrade to 5.5.2 or newer, or switch endpoint.

translator-input-system-too-old.message: {translator} {installed} predates the UnityInput change in 5.5.1; in-game hotkeys will not respond in this new-Input-System game.

engine-version-unknown.message: Unity version could not be read, so version-gated compatibility checks are advisory only for this game.

translator-payload-orphaned.evidence-message: {translator} payload files are present, but no loader able to run them is installed.

translator-duplicate-install.message: {translator} payloads from several loader families are present ({variants}); only one can load.
translator-duplicate-install.fix: Clean up the duplicates, then reinstall the variant that matches this game.

translator-multi-version.message: {translator} files report several versions ({versions}); which one loads is not decidable from disk alone.
translator-multi-version.fix: Clean up and reinstall a single version.

translator-managed-drift.message: {translator} does not match its IndieDeck record (receipt {receipt}, files report {found}).
translator-managed-drift.fix: Review the changed files, then run a repair install.

translator-unmanaged.message: {translator} files are installed without an IndieDeck receipt.
translator-unmanaged.fix: Keep them, or back up and replace them through an IndieDeck install to make them managed.

translator-newer-than-registry.message: {translator} {installed} is newer than the newest release IndieDeck knows; it will be kept as is.

translator-version-unknown.message: {translator} files are present but their version cannot be read from disk or receipts.
translator-version-unknown.fix: Verify manually before any automatic replacement.

translator-receipt-corrupt.message: {count} IndieDeck receipt file(s) could not be trusted ({names}); automatic changes are blocked until this is resolved.

translator-version-conflict.message: {translator} {installed} does not fit this game's engine and backend combination as installed.
translator-version-conflict.fix: Run a repair install so the resolver picks a compatible build.

translator-update-available.message: {translator} {installed} is installed; a better-matching release for this game is available.

plan.loader-unavailable: No registered loader provides "{capability}" for this game.
plan.font-bundle-unresolved: A CJK fallback font is needed but no TMP bundle matches this Unity version - use the TextMeshPro 3.2+ system-font option instead.

font.not-unity: TMP fallback bundles apply to Unity games only.
font.no-target-need: No CJK fallback bundle is recommended for this target language.
font.not-tmp: TextMeshPro was not detected; this TMP bundle is not needed.
font.tmp-unknown: TextMeshPro detection is incomplete. Run a deep scan before choosing a TMP font.
font.unity-unknown: The Unity version is unknown, so a matching TMP bundle cannot be chosen safely.
font.no-matching-bundle: No registered TMP bundle matches Unity {unity} and this language.
font.installed: {file} is present and selected as the TMP fallback font. Runtime rendering still needs to be checked in the game.
font.recommended: {file} matches the registered Unity {unity} range. It supplies Korean, Japanese and Chinese fallback glyphs; test rendering in the game after installation.
font.translator-required: A single compatible installed XUnity.AutoTranslator variant and its loader are required before adding a font separately.

step.loader-manual: {loader} has no downloadable asset for {arch} - install it manually first ({url})
step.backup-managed: Snapshot the game assemblies before ReiPatcher rewrites them
step.run-setup: Run {exe} and then launch through the generated "(Patch and Run)" shortcut once
step.install-tool: Install {translator} into the IndieDeck tools folder
step.download-fonts: Download the TMP font bundle archive ({asset})
step.configure-font: Set only the TMP fallback font in {path} to {file}
step.write-config: Write {path} (created on first launch if missing)

warning.file-missing: {path} does not exist yet - it is generated the first time the game runs with the plugin installed. Values written now will be applied when it appears.
warning.version-unknown: The installed version could not be determined, so the newest known config layout is assumed.
warning.version-from-tag: Version {version} was read from the config's own Migrations tag, not from the installed assembly - treat it as a hint.

validation.assumed-mapping: {label} is being written to [{section}] {key}, assumed from the newest known layout because the installed version is unclear.
validation.unknown-provider: "{endpoint}" is not a provider IndieDeck knows about; its credential fields cannot be checked.
validation.provider-version: {provider} needs translator {min} or newer; {installed} is installed.
validation.missing-credential: {provider} needs {field}, which is not set. Translation will fail until it is.
validation.language-unsupported-source: {provider} does not list "{language}" as a source language{note}.
validation.language-unsupported-target: {provider} does not list "{language}" as a target language{note}.

invalid.engine: "{value}" is not a known translation engine.
invalid.language: "{value}" is not a language code (expected e.g. ko, ja, zh-CN).
invalid.font-bundle: "{value}" is not among the font bundles present in the game folder ({bundles}).

error.invalid-plan: Refusing to write an invalid config plan.
error.no-schema: No config schema is registered for "{translator}".
error.no-location: Could not work out where {translator} keeps its config in this game.

progress.preflight: Checking {translator} {version} against the current game folder
progress.rollback: Restoring the game folder after the failed step

error.no-roots: No library roots configured. Add one with `indiedeck root add <path>`.
error.no-match: No game matching "{query}" - run `indiedeck scan` first, or pass a folder path.
error.registry-missing: Could not locate the IndieDeck registry directory. Set INDIEDECK_REGISTRY to the folder holding engines.json.

settings.title: Settings
settings.manualUpdatesOnly: updates are manual for this build
settings.defaultsHint: Used when plans and compatibility checks are recomputed after you press save.

maintenance.title: Existing Unity translator maintenance
maintenance.description: Review recognized XUnity.AutoTranslator files before cleanup or replacement. No files are deleted merely because a game was scanned.
maintenance.preserve: Game files, loaders, unrelated mods, fonts, translation settings and saved translations are kept. Unknown or unsafe files block automatic cleanup.
maintenance.confirmReinstall: Clean up and reinstall the translator?
maintenance.confirmScope: Only these {count} recognized translator files will be backed up and removed.
maintenance.reinstallScope: After cleanup, install the compatible registered translator build {version}. Existing settings are retained.
maintenance.closeGame: Close the game and external translation tools first. Keep the backup until you have checked the game.

reason.unsupported: Automatic translator cleanup is supported only for detected Unity games with recognized XUnity.AutoTranslator files.
reason.absent: No recognized XUnity.AutoTranslator files were found. Use a normal translator install instead.
reason.receipt: An install record is damaged, unsupported or inconsistent. Review it before removing translator files.
reason.linkedPath: A candidate file or one of its folders is linked or unsafe. Automatic cleanup is blocked.
reason.unknownFile: The translator folder contains unknown, oversized or irregular files. Review them manually before cleanup.
reason.ownership: A translator file is owned by another component or its install record cannot be safely updated. Automatic cleanup is blocked.
reason.host: A compatible existing loader or replacement translator build could not be confirmed. Cleanup may still be available, but automatic reinstallation is blocked.
reason.stale: The game or cleanup preview changed. Refresh and review a new preview.
reason.archive: The replacement download does not match the expected translator-only files. No unrecognized payload will be installed.

archive.title: Game archives and versions
archive.description: Import ZIP games into separate folders and keep each version as its own library entry. The original archive and existing games are not overwritten.
archive.manualOnly: 7z and RAR are recognized but cannot be imported here yet. Extract them yourself and add the extracted game folder.
archive.versionCaveat: Filename version hints are guesses, not verified game versions. Labels help you identify your own copies.
archive.ready: Archive inspected. Review it before importing.
archive.label: Version label (optional)
archive.unregistered: This version is no longer registered in the library. Add its game folder to use it.
archive.complete: Archive imported into a separate game folder.

reason.stale: This archive selection expired. Choose and inspect the file again.
reason.unsupported: This archive cannot be imported automatically.
reason.label: Use a version label of 80 characters or fewer, without control characters.
reason.invalidLabel: The version label is invalid. Use 80 characters or fewer, without control characters.
reason.extractionUnsupported: This 7z/RAR archive is recognized but automatic extraction is not supported yet. Extract it yourself, then add the game folder.
reason.unknownFormat: The file signature does not identify a supported game archive.
reason.invalidZip: The ZIP structure is damaged or unsupported. No game files were imported.
reason.unsafeSource: The archive or import data folder is linked, missing or not a regular local path.
reason.unsafePath: The archive contains an unsafe filename or a path outside its own folder.
reason.reservedMetadata: The archive contains reserved IndieDeck metadata and cannot be safely imported.
reason.linkedEntry: The archive contains a link or non-regular file. Automatic import is blocked.
reason.pathCollision: Archive entries collide on Windows, or a file conflicts with a folder path.
reason.multipart: Split or ZIP64 archives are not supported. Extract this archive manually.
reason.zip64: ZIP64 archives are not supported. Extract this archive manually.
reason.multipleGames: More than one game was found in this archive. Extract it manually and add each game folder separately.
reason.noGame: No supported game folder was found in this archive. Extract and review it manually.
reason.encrypted: Encrypted archives are not supported. Extract this archive manually.
reason.unsupportedCompression: This ZIP uses an unsupported compression method. Extract it manually.
reason.unsupportedEncoding: This ZIP uses unsupported filename encoding. Extract it manually.
reason.limits: This archive exceeds the import size or file-count limits. Extract it manually.
reason.changedArchive: The archive changed after inspection. Choose and inspect it again.
reason.sizeMismatch: An extracted file does not match the archive's declared size. Import stopped.
reason.crcMismatch: An extracted file failed its integrity check. Import stopped.

mtool.title: RPG Maker · local MTool
mtool.description: Opens your existing MTool with this game’s executable. It does not install a second translator or start translation automatically.
mtool.settingsHint: Choose an existing MTool package folder. IndieDeck does not download, copy or update MTool. Disconnecting keeps all MTool files.
mtool.pickTitle: Choose MTool folder (package folder or its Tool subfolder)
mtool.refreshed: Game files rescanned. This does not verify translation worked.
mtool.opened: Requested MTool to open. Select the language and start translation in its window.
mtool.stepOpen: Open the game in MTool. If it is not selected automatically, drag the game executable into MTool.
mtool.stepApply: Select the language and press Start Translation in MTool. Its game detection and translation result must be checked there.
mtool.stepRefresh: After MTool finishes, refresh here to read the latest files.
mtool.externalChanges: MTool may change game files outside IndieDeck’s install records. Back up the game first; IndieDeck’s uninstall action cannot undo those changes.
mtool.concurrentWarning: While MTool is working, do not run translator or mod installs for the same game in IndieDeck. Finish the external task and refresh before continuing.
mtool.runtimeCaveat: This is a local-tool handoff, not verified translation. MTool runtime behavior has not been tested from this launcher.
mtool.gameUnsupported: Only RPG Maker MV, MZ, XP, VX and VX Ace games can currently be connected to MTool.
mtool.gameUnavailable: The game executable is missing or its path is unsafe. Refresh the game folder.
mtool.statusCheckFailed: The current MTool folder could not be checked. Reopen settings to retry before launching it.

reason.disabled: MTool integration is disconnected. Choose its folder to reconnect without changing MTool files.
reason.notFound: MTool was not found at this location. Choose the package folder or its Tool subfolder.
reason.unsupportedPlatform: Opening the local MTool package is currently supported only on Windows.
reason.invalidRoot: This location is not a valid MTool folder. Choose the package folder or its Tool subfolder.
reason.linkedPath: The MTool folder, executable or required package files use a linked path. Choose an ordinary local package folder.
reason.invalidPackage: The expected MTool package files could not be confirmed. Choose the complete package folder, not a shortcut or unrelated executable.
reason.invalidExecutable: The MTool executable is missing, linked or not a regular Windows executable. Check the package folder.
reason.unsupportedGame: This game’s detected engine is not supported by the local MTool integration.
reason.invalidGameExecutable: The game executable is missing, linked or outside the registered game folder. Refresh the game folder before opening MTool.

update.readyBody: The update is downloaded. Choose Restart and install in settings when you are ready; closing IndieDeck alone does not install it.
update.title: Launcher updates
update.availableNotice: IndieDeck {version} is available. Open settings to review the update.
update.downloadedNotice: IndieDeck {version} is downloaded. Restart from settings when ready.
update.explicitSteps: Updates are checked automatically after startup. Download and restart happen only when you choose them; closing the launcher does not install a pending update.
update.manualHelp: Open the official release page and choose the appropriate installer or portable package. This build does not perform in-app updates.
update.finishTask: Finish the active file operation before restarting.
update.confirmTitle: Restart to install the launcher update?
update.confirmBody: IndieDeck will close and launch its update installer. Your games and launcher data are kept. Finish all game file operations first.

status.idle: Ready to check for a launcher update
status.up-to-date: The installed launcher is up to date
status.downloaded: Update downloaded · restart is your choice
status.manual: Use a manual update for this build

reason.portable: Portable builds are updated manually. Download a new portable package from the official release page and keep your data folder.
reason.development: Development or unpacked builds cannot update themselves. Use an official installed release for in-app updates.
reason.disabled: In-app updates are disabled for this build or session. You can review official releases manually.
reason.unsupported: This platform or package does not support in-app updates. Use the official release page.

error.check: The launcher update check failed. Try again or review the official release page.
error.download: The launcher update could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
error.install: The update installer could not be started. Your current launcher remains available; try again when ready.
error.unavailable: The current update state or required update is unavailable. Read the status again before continuing.
error.busy: A launcher or game file task is active, or the downloaded update changed. Finish the task and review the update again before restarting.
error.disposed: The update controller is no longer available for this session. Restart the launcher or use a manual update.
error.reservation: Safe restart could not be reserved. Finish file operations and try again.
error.invalidVersion: The release version could not be confirmed as a valid newer stable version. No automatic update will be applied.
error.network: The update server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.integrity: The update did not pass its integrity or signing check. Do not install it; try again or review the official release.
error.permission: The update could not access the required files. Check permissions and whether another process is using them.
error.cancelled: The launcher update was cancelled. Nothing will be installed automatically.
error.downloadIncomplete: The update download is incomplete. Download it fully before installing.
error.generic: The launcher update could not be completed. Retry or review the official release page.

detail.playBlocked: Play is unavailable while a task runs.
detail.noTranslator: No translator in the registry targets this engine.

font.title: Recommended TMP font
font.fallbackOnly: Uses TMP fallback only: the game keeps its original font and uses this bundle for missing glyphs.
font.runtimeCaveat: Chosen from detected Unity version and registered ranges. Font rendering in this game has not been tested.
font.configured: Font file present · TMP fallback linked
font.presentNotConfigured: Font file present · TMP fallback is not linked
font.standalone: Adds only the recommended font and fallback setting; the installed translator is not reinstalled.
font.withTranslator: Choose “Install recommended TMP font too” in a translator option below.
font.choiceHelp: {file} · TMP fallback; original game font stays unchanged

block.receipt: An install record is damaged or unsupported. Review it before changing the font or settings.
block.payload: The installed translator is duplicated, mismatched or changed. Review it before adding a font.
block.config: The installed translator’s existing config path and TMP fallback key could not be confirmed. Run the game once and check its translation settings first.
block.linkedPath: A font, config or install-record path is a linked folder or not a regular file. Review the path before changing files.
block.existingFont: A font file with this name already exists. Turn off the bundled font option, then use the font card to link the existing file.
block.managedFont: This font already has an IndieDeck install record. Safe font reinstallation and updates are not supported yet; review the existing installation first.

config.notWritten: Nothing written - fix the errors above.

operation.stoppedBeforeChanges: The task stopped before any game files were changed.
operation.failedRollbackPartial: The task failed and some changes could not be restored.
operation.keptModified: {count} hand-edited file(s) were kept and need review.
